text:
mira: Noticing repeated small RTT bursts between eu-west1 <-> ap-southeast1 over last 30m. apiserver leaders briefly lose lease and controller-manager queues spike, which triggers the GPU provisioner to allocate duplicate capacity. graph: https://grafana.internal/d/peering/rt-bursts

ash: digging into kube logs. apiserver leader shows renew timeouts then quick reacquires: 
```
E0621 14:03:42.987 1 leaderelection.go:238] error renewing lease: context deadline exceeded
I0621 14:03:42.988 1 leaderelection.go:263] attempting to acquire leader lease
```
Queue growth: controller-manager workqueue depth ~42k -> 95k in 4m.

devon: provisioner trace shows duplicate reservation attempts for same pod label set within 15s window. It treats unobserved binding as lost and retries immediately.

tilee: current kube flags: controller-manager --leader-elect-renew-deadline=10s --lease-duration=30s. Our observed network RTTs occasionally spike to 300ms with jitter causing renew to fail if combined with GC pauses.

mira: can we try two-prong: (1) quick config bump on controller-manager to reduce churn, (2) short debounce in provisioner to avoid immediate duplicate reservations? Which is quicker?

ash: config bump easiest. I'll roll canary in eu-west1: set renew-deadline=18s and lease-duration=60s on one controller-manager replica. Watch for increased failover time but fewer leader hops.

devon: provisioner debounce needs a small change: if last leader_change < 60s then delay new reservation by 20s. I can ship that as a small admission-layer guard, but needs tests.

ops-bot: Scaling note: hit NAT gateway queueing alarms in ap-southeast1. Suggested quick action: add one extra egress node. ops-bot start-egress ap-southeast1 +1

ops-bot: Executing: egress-gw-ap-southeast1 scale 4 -> 5. ETA ~40s. :rocket:

tilee: applied canary config at 14:07. Monitoring leader_election metrics. So far leader held for 6m without hop.

ash: observed provisioner requeues dropped ~65% after canary. Duplicate GPU allocations reduced. billing spike estimate: +3.8% GPU spend during 20m window.

samir: logging/observability followup: emit metric leader_renew_miss_total{region,instance} and alert on >3 within 5m. Right now we have silent renew failures that only show in logs.

mira: agree. Add alert as P2: leader_renew_miss_total{region=~"eu-.*|ap-.*"} > 3 for 5m -> notify eng-sre + networking.

devon: created a small admission-layer debounce PR and opened tests. I'll mark it for review. If we can't merge fast, we can patch the provisioner config to add a 30s backoff on requeues.

tilee: ops note: we also bumped NIC coalescing counters during last kernel roll on ap-southeast1 nodes. Possibility: IRQ coalescing caused micro-bursts. I'll coordinate with infra to revert the coalescing tweak on a small set of peering boxes as an experiment.

ash: repro steps documented for postmortem: 
```
# simulate 250-350ms RTT jitter from eu -> ap
kubectl -n kube-system exec leader-sim -- ./chaos-lease --lease 10s --jitter-ms 300 --freq 5s
# watch leaderelection logs and controller-manager queue depth
```

mira: action items (short list):
- roll controller-manager lease settings to other clusters (staged canary)
- deploy leader_renew_miss metric & alert
- temp: add egress autoscale tweak in ap-southeast1 and review NAT gp2 limits
- medium: merge provisioner debounce/admission guard
- medium: infra test revert NIC coalescing tweak on peering fleet
- long: engage peering provider for packet pacing / QoS docs

samir: I'll own the alert + metric. devon owns provisioner debounce. tilee will handle NIC roll-back experiment. ash will coordinate the staged controller-manager rollout.

mira: thanks all. I'll file the incident ticket and link this thread. Keep updates here; add any regressions or rollbacks. :eyes:
